title: Noretta
novel: The gang made a [[disturbing|disturb]] [[discovery|discovery]] about their romantic [[partners|partner]]. They [[realized|realize]] that each person's partner reminded them of one of their parents. This [[revelation|revelation]] [[shocked|shock]] everyone and made them feel very [[uncomfortable|uncomfortable]]. Barney and Nora [[planned|plan]] a [[romantic|romantic]] evening together. Barney wanted everything to be [[perfect|perfect]] for their special night. He [[reserved|reserve]] a nice table at an expensive restaurant. He even bought flowers and a small [[gift|gift]]. However, the [[revelation|revelation]] about parents kept [[bothering|bother]] him during the date. He could not stop thinking about the fact that Nora [[reminded|remind]] him of his mother. Nora noticed that Barney was acting [[strangely|strange]] and asked if something was wrong. Barney tried to [[deny|deny]] it, but his [[behavior|behavior]] was clearly [[affected|affect]]. Marshall and Lily also had an [[awkward|awkward]] conversation about this [[realization|realize]]. They laughed about it but also felt a bit weird. Ted tried to [[comfort|comfort]] the group by saying that people naturally look for [[familiar|familiar]] [[qualities|quality]] in partners. He said it was a common [[psychological|psychological]] [[phenomenon|phenomenon]]. The gang eventually decided to just laugh about it and move on. They agreed that love was complicated and sometimes unexplainable.

discovery.en: finding something for the first time

partner.en: a person you are in a relationship with

plan.en: to decide what you will do

reserve.en: to keep something for later use

deny.en: to say something is not true
